description: The body positions both keys share: an exercise key's orientation (o) and an equipment key's posture (s). impliedPoints are the body points the position bears weight on, which a support layer never writes.

entries.description: On the feet, trunk within about 30° of vertical.
On the feet, trunk hinged forward more than about 30° and held there (bent-over row).
On the feet, trunk resting on a pad, upright or bent over (donkey calf raise machine).
Sitting, trunk more than 60° from horizontal.
Sitting, trunk hinged forward over the thighs and held there (seated bent-over raise).
Sitting, chest against a pad that holds the trunk (row machine, rear-delt machine).
On both knees, trunk upright. On hands and knees is `prone`.
On one knee, the other foot forward.
Face up, trunk within 15° of horizontal.
Face up, head higher than hips, trunk 15–60° from horizontal.
Face up, head lower than hips, trunk 15–60° from horizontal.
Face down, trunk within 15° of horizontal: lying, plank, push-up, on hands and knees.
Face down, head higher than hips, 15–60° (hands raised).
Face down, head lower than hips, 15–60° (feet raised).
Face down, hips highest, hands and feet down, trunk more than 60° head-down (pike).
On one side: lying, or a side plank.
Held up by the hands or arms, feet off the floor: hanging from a bar, propped on dip bars.
Upside down, trunk within 30° of vertical, head lowest: handstand, headstand.
